mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox (id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, type, payload, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{type}, #{payload}, NOW(3))
mapper.select: SELECT id, type, payload FROM outbox WHERE id=#{id} AND aggregate_type='following' AND type IN ('FollowCreated', 'FollowCanceled') LIMIT 1
SELECT id, type, payload FROM outbox WHERE id BETWEEN #{fromId} AND #{toId} AND aggregate_type='following' AND type IN ('FollowCreated', 'FollowCanceled') ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) FROM outbox WHERE aggregate_type = 'counter_reaction' AND type = 'CounterReactionChanged' AND created_at <= TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, -5, NOW(3))

SELECT o.id, o.type, o.payload, 1 AS pending FROM outbox o LEFT JOIN counter_event_inbox i ON i.event_id = CAST(o.id AS CHAR CHARACTER SET ascii) WHERE o.aggregate_type = 'counter_reaction' AND o.type = 'CounterReactionChanged' AND o.id > #{afterId} AND o.id <= #{throughId} AND o.created_at <= TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, -5, NOW(3)) AND (i.event_id IS NULL OR (i.side_effects_published_at IS NULL AND i.applied_at <= TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, -5, NOW(3)))) ORDER BY o.id LIMIT #{limit}
